## Purpose and ownership

This directory owns optional VS Code workspace guidance. It directly owns `extensions.json` and `settings.json`.

Keep settings repository-specific and portable. Do not make editor configuration the only place a required build, formatting, or verification rule is expressed; put required behavior in manifests, scripts, or documentation as well.
